# YorpHives

> YorpHives is a build-led digital platform: people and businesses bring ideas and challenges to build; visitors use free browser tools; users discover applications built by YorpHives; members use Builder to discover earning opportunities; AI agents discover documented platform capabilities.

## Human-facing sections

- Home: https://yorphives.com/ — custom build requests, measured product activity, recent releases, and platform pathways.
- Free Tools: https://yorphives.com/free-tools/ — 30 browser-based utilities, searchable by category.\n- Free Tools machine-readable catalogue: https://yorphives.com/api/v1/free-tools (JSON by default; Markdown via Accept: text/markdown).\n- Free Tools static manifest: https://yorphives.com/free-tools/manifest.json
- Explore: https://yorphives.com/explore/ — applications built and released by YorpHives only.
- Builder: https://yorphives.com/builder/ — planned paid membership workspace for developers, creators, bloggers, freelancers, designers and entrepreneurs to discover earning opportunities.
- Connect: https://yorphives.com/connect/ — project enquiries.
- Contact: connect@yorphives.com

## Machine-readable discovery

- Platform manifest: https://yorphives.com/.well-known/yorphives.json
- OpenAPI: https://yorphives.com/openapi.yaml
- Public catalogue: https://yorphives.com/api/v1/catalogue
- Catalogue detail: https://yorphives.com/api/v1/catalogue/{slug}\n- Trending tools: https://yorphives.com/api/v1/trending (seven-day measured detail views + launches)\n- First-party usage events: POST https://yorphives.com/api/v1/catalogue/{slug}/usage (same-origin browser events)

The catalogue returns JSON by default and Markdown when requested with Accept: text/markdown or ?format=markdown. Only reviewed and available listings are public.

## Agentic Internet principles

YorpHives is being developed for both people and autonomous agents. The same canonical service contracts should power human interfaces and machine interfaces. Agent execution must be authenticated, authorized, rate-limited, auditable, and explicit about side effects. Discovery does not imply permission to execute.

Cloudflare Workers/Pages Functions provide edge routing and API execution; D1 stores relational platform state; Durable Objects are reserved for coordination requiring strong consistency; Workflows or Queues handle reliable asynchronous work where appropriate. Business logic and API contracts should remain portable.

## Payments and trust

Dodo Payments is the selected provider for Builder memberships and paid applications. Entitlements must be created or changed only after signed provider webhooks are verified server-side and processed idempotently. Browser success redirects are not proof of payment. Cancellation, expiration, refunds and chargebacks must reconcile access.

## Truthful availability

This platform is being developed in stages and remains under active development. Builder paid access, Dodo checkout, identity and agent execution are not yet live. MCP tools are not yet live; some catalogue workflows are also still in development. Do not infer that a capability is available just because it is described here; do not assume undocumented endpoints exist. Trending rankings must use measured, privacy-conscious usage data; never fabricate popularity.
